name: Shinryouji Torajirou
source:
Torajirou is the headmaster of the school, a veteran over-decorated with medals and honours and also [url=/c17125]Hisui[/url]'s grandfather. He has a remarkable presence that commands the respect of everyone, no one can conceive him as anything other than a man educated as a Spartan.

Yet he shows a completely different aspect of his personality when he is accompanied by his granddaughter, who is his pride and joy and the object of all his love, leaving more than one soul completely lost in the front of such a spectacle.
